description.zh: 魔法机器有几个数字按钮，规则卡写着「按几号 → 发生什么」，规则每一题都重新编，所以必须读卡，不能靠常识或记忆。孩子选了以后，选错不判红叉，机器会演示这样按实际发生了什么，再换一个试。K1–K2 是正向预测：按下几号会发生什么（K2 的选项都来自规则卡，必须看对那一行）；G1 反过来想：想让某件事发生该按几号，有时要两件事同时发生，选哪两个按钮；G2 加上「接着」连锁卡：一件事会引起下一件事，既要顺着推最后发生什么，也要倒着找该按哪个。完成即通过，一次想对且没用提示多一个 ⭐，重试和提示次数记入报告。
description.en: A magic machine has numbered buttons and rule cards saying "press this number → this happens". The rules are drawn fresh every question, so they must be read - they cannot be guessed from common sense or memory. A wrong choice is not marked red: the machine shows what that press really does, and the child tries again. K1-K2 predict forward: what happens when this number is pressed (K2 options all come from the cards, so the right row must be found). G1 works backwards: which number makes it happen, sometimes two things at once with two buttons. G2 adds "then" chain cards: one thing triggers the next, so the child follows a chain forward to the last effect and works backward to the right button. Finishing passes, right first with no hints earns a star, and retries and hints go into the report.

designModel.zh: 主轴是规则卡数量（rule_count 两到五张）与提问方向（direction：正向预测、反向推按钮、两者都有），配合链深（chain_depth：单步、两步连锁）。规则每题现编，按钮用数字，效果带名称，不靠颜色或常识。
designModel.en: The primary axes are rule card count (rule_count, two to five) and question direction (direction: forward, backward, both), paired with chain depth (chain_depth: single step or two-hop chain). Rules are drawn per question, buttons are numbers and effects carry names, so nothing relies on colour or common sense.

ageRange.noteZh: K1 两张规则卡、单步正向预测适合 3-4 岁；G2 三张规则卡、两步链式推理约 7 岁。
ageRange.noteEn: K1's two rule cards with a single forward-predict step suit ages 3-4; G2's three rule cards with a two-hop chain suit about age 7.

seriesBoundary.policyZh: 本模块属小精灵系列 · 策略大师。训练的是『读懂一套现编的因果规则，正向预测结果或反向推出该做什么，并能顺着连锁推两步』；错了不判红叉，而是演示实际发生了什么再让孩子调整。与 DECISION.PLANNING 的区别是本模块不在多个方案间比较取舍，也不涉及 energy-planner 的资源约束计算。
seriesBoundary.policyEn: This module belongs to MindSeeds · Strategy Master. It trains applying a given causal rule forward to predict an effect, backward to find the action that causes a wanted effect, and chaining that rule across two steps. This differs from the general 'weigh options and order steps' skill behind RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING — this module never compares multiple options against each other, and it does not involve the resource-constraint arithmetic in energy-planner.

geneReporting.ruleZh: 每次 Attempt 上报 RG.STRATEGY.PREDICT.CONSEQUENCE，不随等级变化。
geneReporting.ruleEn: Every attempt reports RG.STRATEGY.PREDICT.CONSEQUENCE, regardless of grade.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 题面上规则卡（按钮卡加连锁卡）的数量，从两张到五张。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: How many rule cards (button cards plus chain cards) are on screen, from two up to five.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: forward_predict 给按钮找效果；goal_directed 给效果找按钮（可能要同时满足两个）；both 在连锁里两种问法都会出现。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: forward_predict gives the button and asks for the effect; goal_directed gives the wanted effect (sometimes two) and asks for the button; both mixes the two inside chains.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: one_hop 只用一张规则卡；two_hop 把一张卡的效果当成下一张卡的动作，顺着推两步才能到最终结果。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: one_hop uses a single rule card; two_hop treats one card's effect as the next card's trigger, so the child must follow two steps to reach the final result.

sessionPolicy.noteZh: 一次 8 题，通过线 75%（6/8）。没有静态题库：generator.js 现生成，玩完立即换一批。
sessionPolicy.noteEn: Eight items per run, passing at 75% (6/8). No static bank: generator.js builds each set and a new one is swapped in when the run ends.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 两张规则卡，正向预测按下几号会发生什么。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Two rule cards - predict what happens when a number is pressed.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 三张规则卡，选项都来自规则卡，要看对那一行。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Three rule cards; every option comes from the cards, so the right row must be found.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 四张规则卡，反过来想：想让某件事发生该按几号，有时要两件事同时发生。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Four rule cards, worked backwards: which number makes it happen, sometimes two things at once.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 三张按钮卡加两张连锁卡：顺着推最后发生什么，或倒着找该按哪个。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Three button cards and two chain cards: follow the chain to the last effect, or work back to the right button.

statistics.noteZh: 报告 process 带 tiers、retries（重试次数）、hints；directions 区分正向预测与反向推。
statistics.noteEn: The report process carries tiers, retries and hints; directions separate forward prediction from backward reasoning.
